name: -m
--model
options.description: Model

options.name: --advisor
options.description: Advisor model selector for this session. Use "off" to disable native Advisor for this run

options.name: --fallback-model
options.description: Fallback model(s) for capacity errors (429/503/529), repeatable or comma-separated (max 3)

name: -p
--prompt
options.description: Prompt. Appended to input on stdin (if any). [deprecated: Use the positional prompt instead. This flag will be removed in a future version.]

--yolo

options.name: --acp
options.description: Starts the agent in ACP mode

options.name: --experimental-lsp
options.description: Enable experimental LSP (Language Server Protocol) feature for code intelligence

options.name: --channel
options.description: Channel identifier (VSCode, ACP, SDK, CI, desktop, daemon)

options.name: --allowed-mcp-server-names

--list-extensions

options.name: --screen-reader

options.name: --input-format
options.description: The format consumed from standard input

name: -o
--output-format
options.description: The format of the CLI output

options.name: --include-partial-messages

options.name: --json-fd

options.name: --json-schema

options.name: --input-file

name: -c
--continue
options.description: Resume the most recent session for the current project

name: -r

options.name: --exclude-tools
